title: Geometric descent of a local fixed-realization Isom
statement: A local isomorphism between the fixed-realization images of the normalized constant model and the supplied étale complex on a pro-étale covering sieve yields, through every geometric point of the base, an étale neighbourhood carrying a section of the pro-étale derived Isom presheaf.

source.place: Tags 099Y, 099Z, 09B1 and 09BV; lifting a geometric point and reflecting a local inverse pair.

proof.text: Lift the chosen geometric point to a member of the covering sieve, reflect the local isomorphism through the explicit fixed-realization equivalence, and restrict to an étale neighbourhood of the lifted point. The resulting inverse pair maps to the required derived Isom presheaf section.
